MANAGER_ROLES (frontend/apps/ppt-web/src/routes/shared.tsx:36-42) is manager/org_admin/super_admin/technical_manager/property_manager only, so no tenant can reach the page — the dispute path and its UI are dead for their intended audience. Either widen requiredRoles or drop the tenant branch.

signals.source: Phase 1.5 rotating expert review 2026-11-22 ppt-web-ui (churn-aligned; frontend)
evidence: paymentUpdate converts invoice.paid_amount / total_amount (backend decimal strings) to JS Number, adds amount, then classifies status with `paid + 0.005 >= total ? 'paid' : 'partially_paid'`. The 0.005 tolerance papers over binary-float rounding rather than fixing it; for invoices with many fractional-cent payments or large totals, repeated partial payments can misclassify. Compare in decimal-string arithmetic (match the sqlx Decimal flow server-side) or let the server return the final status.
